intro: Call of Water is a quest centered in Westfall that tasks adventurers with purifying corrupted elemental forces. By unraveling restless spirits with radiant Light, players commune with a Minor Manifestation of Water to safeguard the region's dwindling vitality.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Light erupts as the final word leaves your lips. The hiss of water turning to mist fades into silence, and your senses reel as the corrupt spirits around you unravel, their essence scattered like ash in the wind.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thanks to you. Thanks to the adventurers.
Corruption ebbs but life continues to wane. Up to adventurers to protect life.
